subject: Strategic onramp roadmap — multivendor mitigation and vendor lead-time ask
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-systems.com>, Sasha Lee <sasha.lee@acme-systems.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic onramp roadmap — multivendor mitigation and vendor lead-time ask

Alex / Sasha —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. To keep the target go-live window of mid-September realistic, we need to land a short list of confirmed lead-times and committed capacity by the end of May. I pulled together a succinct ask so procurement can align with your OEM partners and cloud marketplace contacts: 

- Confirm whether ACME prefers Dedicated (Redwood Dedicated) vs. a hybrid (Reserved cloud + Dedicated burst). We can support either but need a direction for capacity commitments.
- Ask OEM vendors for firm lead times (order to delivery) for the GPU models we discussed and any expedited options or priority lanes.
- Ask CloudCo procurement whether they can reserve a regional pool (us-west-2) with a soft commit by July and firm start date by Aug 15.
- Provide an initial mutual action plan (MAP) by 5/20 with milestones for PO, SOW, and onboarding windows.

Dev — can you attach the sizing estimate and a two-track fallback plan (OEM on-prem timeline vs cloud reserve fallback)? Marcus / Neha — can you lead the commercial ask (expedite, discounts, ramp credits) with ACME?

Short, actionable replies preferred. I want us to finish the MAP draft next week.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415 555 0198

Attachment: RW-ACME-sizing-estimate.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-systems.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Lee <sasha.lee@acme-systems.com>, procurement@cloudco.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:44:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Strategic onramp roadmap — multivendor mitigation and vendor lead-time ask

Lauren —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick clarifications from our side:

- ACME preference: leaning Dedicated for the first 6 months (security + predictable perf), but open to hybrid if that materially shortens our path to production.
- Can you quantify the incremental cost and delivery delta between Dedicated-only vs hybrid for the 200k qps-days profile you included?

Procurement (cc'd): please escalate to your OEM contacts and let us know what their current promised lead-times look like. Our legal/compliance team will also inspect the SOW template, so a clean MAP helps.

Thanks —
Alex Ramos
Director, AI Product — ACME Systems

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-systems.com>, Sasha Lee <sasha.lee@acme-systems.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic onramp roadmap — multivendor mitigation and vendor lead-time ask

Alex / Sasha —

Thanks — attaching the sizing estimate (same as sent by Lauren) and a short two-track runbook: Dedicated-first (reserve 6x A100-equivalent DGX nodes in Dedicated pool; expected per-token latency target 70–90ms) vs Hybrid (50% Reserved cloud capacity + 50% Dedicated burst). TL;DR: hybrid can shorten initial availability by ~6–8 weeks if CloudCo can confirm reservation by July, but at ~12–18% higher steady-state cost for the first 3 months due to cross-provider egress and reserved commitment mechanics.

Key constraints and asks for OEMs:
- Firm ETA for model-hosting racks (order→config→test→ship) per SKU. Please provide both standard and expedited lead-times.
- Whether OEM will provide pre-staging or depot-testing to reduce on-site validation time.
- Compatibility confirmation for our quantized runtime (we rely on specific kernel builds).

Attachment: OEM_quote_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 86 KB)

On quoting: if OEMs can commit to a 10–12 week delivery with a 3-week pre-staging option, we can meet mid-September with a 4-week parallel validation window. If OEM is 14+ weeks, hybrid reserve becomes the only safe path for launch.

—Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-systems.com>, procurement@cloudco.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic onramp roadmap — multivendor mitigation and vendor lead-time ask

Alex / CloudCo procurement —

Two commercial notes from our side:
1) Staged onramp proposal: 30% committed baseline (Dedicated), 40% hybrid-reserved pool for months 1–3, 30% burst on demand. We can offer ramp credits in month 1 to offset cloud reservation overhead if CloudCo will accept a soft hold on capacity now and convert to firm by Aug 1.
2) OEM expedite: if OEM vendor offers a priority lane (+20% cost), that needs to be considered against the incremental cost of Cloud reserved capacity.

Action: procurement@cloudco.com — can you confirm whether a soft-reserve is doable and what the conversion notice window is? Alex, we will also push for OEM price protection for 90 days on any quote provided.

—Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: none
From: sales@oemvendor.ai <sales@oemvendor.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-systems.com>
Cc: Sasha Lee <sasha.lee@acme-systems.com>, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: OEM preliminary quote and lead-times for RW-ACME-378

Hi all —

Thanks for the inquiry. Please find our preliminary quote and lead-time matrix attached. Key items:
- Standard lead-time (order→configured rack→ship): 12–14 weeks for Model-A (A100-equivalent family).
- Expedited lead-time (priority lane): 8–10 weeks, subject to 20% expedite fee and a 50% non-refundable deposit.
- We can offer depot pre-staging and burn-in testing at our regional facility (adds 1 week to standard lead-time but reduces onsite validation from 3 weeks to 5 days).
- Price protection: quotes are valid for 45 days.

Attachment: OEM_quote_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 86 KB)

If you need a formal master supply agreement and SLAs for staging, we can share a draft next week.

Regards,
OEM Vendor Sales
OEM Vendor, Inc.
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-systems.com>, procurement@cloudco.com, sales@oemvendor.ai
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic onramp roadmap — multivendor mitigation and vendor lead-time ask

Team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Summary and agreed immediate actions so everyone has a single source of truth: 

1) Path chosen: Hybrid-first for launch safety. We will reserve a CloudCo regional pool sufficient for 50% of expected load and negotiate a conversion window to Dedicated as OEM capacity arrives. This balances launch timing vs cost.
2) OEM commitments: OEM provided preliminary lead-times (12–14 wks standard; 8–10 wks expedite). Action: ACME to confirm whether they will authorize a 50% expedite deposit if we need to push to 8–10 weeks.
3) Pre-staging: OEM offers depot pre-staging (recommended). Dev, please schedule validation slots with OEM depot to shave onsite validation time.
4) Commercials: Marcus/Neha will propose a ramp credit structure and request 90-day price protection on OEM quotes.
5) MAP timeline: deliverable by 2027-05-26 — includes PO timing, SOW signoff, CloudCo soft-reserve confirmation, and OEM deposit decision.

Next steps / owners:
- ACME (Alex / Sasha): confirm expedite authorization and preferred path (Dedicated-only vs Hybrid-first) by 2027-05-24.
- CloudCo procurement: confirm soft-reserve terms and conversion notice by 2027-05-26.
- OEM Vendor: provide formal MSPA/draft staging SLA by 2027-05-24.
- Dev: schedule depot test windows and produce validation checklist by 2027-05-22.
- Marcus/Neha: MAP + commercial proposal by 2027-05-26.

I’ll draft the MAP template and drop into the shared drive linked below; please comment directly in the doc rather than in-line email edits to keep the thread readable.

Thanks — tight timeline but doable if we keep action owners to those dates.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: HubSpot_RW-ACME-378.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)
